title: Email: Fw: Let's talk travel soon

content.text:
Anthony Fenech
Tigers beat writer
Detroit Free Press
(734) 752-9667
Twitter: @anthonyfenech
From: Thomas, Christopher <cdthomas@freepress.com>
Sent: Thursday, December 27, 2018 2:36 PM
To: Fenech, Anthony <afenech@freepress.com>
Subject: Let's talk travel soon 
 
To help us avoid some cuts, I’m stripping some travel from mostly all of our beats.
But I think we can spread it out enough to where you’re not away from the team for any extended period of time.
We’ll dial back spring training a bit for now, too, with the understanding that when the Tigers are good again we’ll ramp it back up.
Let me know when works for you. I don’t want to interfere with your time off. But just make sure we talk before you book anything.
